ambient_events: Somebody stops on the kerb to retie a shoe.
A street sweeper goes by on Sorrel Way with its brushes up.
A sparrow lands on the kerb, finds nothing and goes.
description: A flowerbed in a stone kerb between 4 Sorrel Way and Fitz's Franks, with a clipped hedge along the pavement. The planting is the same as the bed two plots along.
name: Sorrel Gardens
